## Crash report

If the viewer closed unexpectedly, it wrote a report. Attaching it is the
single most useful thing in this form. It contains the version, the thread and
the crash location, plus the last log lines -- and deliberately no scan paths.

- Windows: `%APPDATA%\OccluView\crashes\`
- Linux: `~/.local/state/OccluView/crashes/` (or `$XDG_STATE_HOME/OccluView/crashes/`)
